chapters.title: Riverglades: pickups and loose ends
chapters.note: Starts where chapter 41 ends: Farholde Keep, hearth bound there. After the 13 Nov recheck no quest here is certain: every leftover Riverglades quest either follows an out quest in Wowhead's series (Biting the Hand, Her World, News to Farholde, The Twilight Threat) or needs a low drop (What We Lost, out). They are written as 'if he offers it' lines on one loop: Powderfuse Port for Friz Frazzlespark's errands (I Know a Guy for Booty Bay and From Port to Port for Feathermoon are plain pickups; Shipping and Handling only if the optional smuggling block of chapter 41 was done), Sunnyglade, Sergeant Riftan at the Twilight's Shroud (30.7,49.1) for Twilight Mementos, Demar Brant and Ashe Amberhall at the Keep for Eye of Mugg and Tome of Twilight. The chapter's sure job is those dungeon pickups. Draft spec: `Claude outputs/40-50-specs-2026-11-13/42-draft.md`.

chapters.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (dungeon)
chapters.note: Required dungeon chapter, one run. Every mob Wowhead lists for it is Elite and none shows a level; the quests are level 41-45, so 'wants 42' is the draft spec's low-confidence call. The chapter opens with the Ironforge training stop (level 42 row) and the Southshore flight to the Dalaran crater for Vengeance of the Highborne (Ranath Nightstride, Alterac 17.8,66.0), hearths back for the run, and hands that quest in at the crater afterwards. Tome of Twilight and Eye of Mugg hang on one boss each. Twilight Mementos (8 bangles at 11%) is grind / luck, and Lingering Essence and Curios of Curiosity follow it in Wowhead's series, so they are conditional; Key Ingredients follows the Krol'dok Moulding that Tunk drops (48%). Eye of Mugg's Bigger Rock on Bigger Stick ties Rage of the Storm and Bonebiter within 1% in the kill-speed model. Draft spec: `43-draft.md`. On the same crater visit The Witch Doctor's Head (96770) is taken from Archmage Lan'dalock (Alterac 15.3,73.9) for the Zul'Farrak run of chapter 51; it is handed in on the eastern trip of chapter 52.

chapters.title: Stormwind, the Temple door and Aerie Peak
chapters.note: From Ironforge by tram. Stormwind: Brohann Caskbelly's In Search of The Temple, Mazen's Behest, Vital Supplies; one loop Darkshire - Nethergarde Keep - the Pool of Tears - Nethergarde - Stormwind does the supply run and the Temple door (Mukomonji, a level 62 elite, stands 2.5 units west of the Pool's trigger). Back at Brohann, To The Hinterlands; then Ironforge - Aerie Peak for Falstad, Gryphon Master Talonaxe and Rhapsody Shindigger, whose Kalimdor Kocktail is picked up here for Tanaris and Feralas. Artisan Leatherworking at Drakk Stonehand (skill 200, 5g) and Farseer Maret Firetend's level 42 row fall here. The Twilight Threat and Delivering Closure are handed in at Stormwind only if he has them. The Badlands trip is dropped (Braedyn, 13 Nov). Draft specs to re-cut: `44-draft.md`, `45-draft.md`.

chapters.title: Booty Bay
chapters.note: Aerie Peak - Ironforge - Stormwind - Booty Bay by flight; bind at Booty Bay for this chapter. Friz's caravan chain with Caravaneer Ruzzgot (I Know a Guy, Get the Goods, We've Been Robbed!, and now The Big Payback: one shipment at 29% from the Venture Co. Agents at the ledger, about four kills), Raptor Mastery's third part at Nesingwary's camp, and Scaring Shaky with Return to MacKinley (five giblets from about 19 Elder Mistvale Gorillas south of Booty Bay). Pickups for later: All's Well That Ends Well (Ruzzgot, handed in to Friz in chapter 48), Stoley's Debt and Tran'rek for Tanaris, Voodoo Dues for the Cape chapter, Twice Misplaced Trust if offered. The Bloodsail Trunk's position is not in the data. The chapter ends on the Booty Bay - Ratchet boat.

chapters.title: Tanaris I
chapters.note: Gadgetzan and Steamwheedle Port, quest levels 40-46. Gadgetzan's flight point is not known yet: the first trip is by road from Ratchet through the Barrens and the Shimmering Flats (unverified). Bind at Gadgetzan. The Wastewander and Southsea quests, the two WANTED posters, Gnomish Garbage, the Screecher Spirits pickup for Feralas, and about 25 Rocs for Rhapsody's three gizzards. Deliver to MacKinley is carried to Booty Bay (chapter 49). Ship Schedules and the OOX-17/TN robot start from drops under 1% and are 'if it drops' lines. Friz's Steamwheedle chain is conditional on the optional smuggling block of chapter 41. Artisan Cooking (Clamlette Surprise at Dirge Quikcleave, Cooking 225) is a gate stop here.

chapters.title: Feralas I
chapters.note: Feathermoon Stronghold, quest levels 41-45. First trip by road: Gadgetzan - Thousand Needles - Thalanaar (flight point) - through Feralas to the Forgotten Coast boat (unverified). The naga and Gordunni quests, the Missing Courier chain, Friz's delivery, the screecher spirits, and the Ironfur bears and Groddoc apes for Rhapsody's livers. The OOX-22/FE robot starts from a beacon at 0.34% per kill and The Old Key from a crate whose side Wowhead does not state: both are 'if' lines. The chapter ends at Thalanaar with Thalanaar Delivery.

chapters.title: The Hinterlands
chapters.note: Back east: Thalanaar - Theramore by flight, the Menethil boat, Aerie Peak. Rhapsody's Kocktail is handed in and Rhapsody's Tale taken; Witherbark Cages and The Altar of Zul lead to Thadius Grimshade (Nethergarde, next chapter), which opens Nekrum's Medallion for Zul'Farrak; Skulk Rock; and Troll Necklace Bounty (five necklaces from the Vilebranch at the Altar, about 15 kills). QuestieDB puts two level 50 elites beside the Altar's trigger: in-game check. Then Farholde Keep and the ride to Powderfuse Port: All's Well That Ends Well to Friz, and his two conditional hand-ins if held. The chapter ends in Ironforge (level 44 row). Out or later: both Jintha'Alor quests (level 51 elites); the OOX-09/HL robot (beacon 0.58%, an 'if' line); Repurposed Totems needs level 45 and waits for round 3's return to Aerie Peak.

chapters.title: Nethergarde and the Cape of Stranglethorn
chapters.note: From Ironforge (Tabetha's Task from Bink for chapter 50) to Stormwind: Rhapsody's Tale to Brohann Caskbelly (Into The Temple of Atal'Hakkar is taken for round 3). Stormwind - Nethergarde Keep: Thadius Grimshade, who gives Nekrum's Medallion for the Zul'Farrak run. Then Booty Bay: Deliver to MacKinley, The Bloodsail Buccaneers (the captains run to level 48), Stranglethorn Fever (Mokk the Savage, Normal on Wowhead), and Voodoo Dues as a one-kill-each try at the three named ogres. Cortello's Riddle is picked up on the Bloodsail ship and carried to round 3; Whiskey Slim's Lost Grog waits for round 3 with it. Message in a Bottle needs level 45 and is an 'if you are 45' line. Any OOX rescue in the log is handed in to Oglethorpe. The chapter ends on the Ratchet boat.

chapters.title: Feralas II
chapters.note: Ratchet - Theramore by flight. Sword in the Slime from Guard Jameson, then the ride to Tabetha's farm (Dustwallow 46.1,57.1): Tabetha's Task in, Tiara of the Deep out, and the oozes beside the farm for Jameson's sword (35%, about three kills); back to Theramore and on by flight to Thalanaar and Feathermoon. Quest levels 46-51 on required levels up to 44: the Writhing Deep, Doling Justice, the Feathermoon library errands, the giants. Predicted entry is two levels under the mobs: the spec orders the legs by mob level. Doling Justice, Rise of the Silithid and In Search of Knowledge are carried to Darnassus (chapter 55). The Sunken Temple needs level 46 at Feathermoon and is left for round 3 with The Stone Circle; the Sprite Darter chain's tail (An Orphan Looking For a Home onward) runs to Thousand Needles and the Hinterlands after Darnassus and is left for round 3.

chapters.title: Zul'Farrak (dungeon)
chapters.note: Required dungeon chapter, one run. Feathermoon - Thalanaar - Gadgetzan by flight; bind at Gadgetzan. Screecher Spirits is handed in to Yeh'kinya at Steamwheedle Port first, which opens The Prophecy of Mosh'aru. In the log from earlier chapters: Nekrum's Medallion (chapter 49), Tiara of the Deep (chapter 50), The Witch Doctor's Head (chapter 43), Tran'rek's quests. Mobs inside are level 43-48 in the DB and every boss is ranked elite there; predicted entry is about 44.5, the low end for this dungeon. The boss-item quests are labelled normal with a one-kill note. Troll Temper (16% from the trolls) is grind / luck. Gahz'rilla has to be summoned and is optional. Three of the run's quests are handed in on the eastern trip of chapter 52: Tiara of the Deep, Nekrum's Medallion and The Witch Doctor's Head.

chapters.title: Tabetha, Nethergarde, the crater and the Searing Gorge
chapters.note: The eastern trip that the required levels force (13 Nov): the Searing Gorge quests and the Explorers' League chains need level 45, which the route reaches here and not before. Gadgetzan - Theramore: Tiara of the Deep to Tabetha. The Menethil boat, Ironforge, Stormwind - Nethergarde Keep: Nekrum's Medallion to Thadius Grimshade and The Divination (Return to the Hinterlands is left for round 3). Southshore and the Dalaran crater: The Witch Doctor's Head. Then the Searing Gorge on foot (Thorium Point's flight point is not known; which pass is open on Forever is unverified): the Suntara Stones and Caught! / The Key to Freedom first (required level 40-43), then the board and Thorium Brotherhood quests at 45. Last, in Ironforge at 45: Portents of Uldum, Passing the Burden, An Easy Pickup and Signal for Pickup at the Explorers' League, and the level 46 row if he has it. The Kalaran Windblade chain stops where its targets turn elite.

chapters.title: Tanaris II and Uldum
chapters.note: Menethil - Theramore by boat, Theramore - Gadgetzan by flight. Quest levels 47-51: the silithid chain from Noxious Lair Investigation (five insect parts at 51%, about ten kills), the Dunemaul compound (Gor'marok, Normal on Wowhead), Thistleshrub Valley, the Gahz'ridian ornaments, Tooga, the egg-o-matic, and the Uldum pedestal for the Explorers' League. Handle With Care and Rise of the Silithid are carried to Darnassus (chapter 55). The OOX-17/TN robot is an 'if the beacon drops' line.

chapters.title: Maraudon (dungeon)
chapters.note: Required dungeon chapter, entered from Desolace (Gadgetzan - Theramore - Nijel's Point by flight). Mobs inside are level 43-51 in the DB; the predicted entry is about 46, so the spec decides whether the outer wings are run here and the inner falls later, the way Scarlet Monastery was split. The Shadowshard Fragments (46%) and the Theradric Crystal Carvings (27%) are collections and are grind / luck. Seed of Life is taken from Zaetar's Spirit and carried: it is handed in at Moonglade, round 3.

chapters.title: Darnassus and Azshara
chapters.note: Nijel's Point - Auberdine - Rut'theran by flight (all known). Darnassus and Rut'theran take the hand-ins the route has been carrying: Doling Justice, both Rise of the Silithid quests, In Search of Knowledge, Feralas: A History, Handle With Care; The Borrower is taken for Gadgetzan and Sisters In Duty for Azshara. Then Auberdine - Astranaar and the road to Talrendis Point, new on Forever (flight point not known). Quest levels 47-55: the required-level 45 quests come first (Tymor's Arcane Runes, Home on the Range: five hides from about 11 Mosshoof Runners), the nine that need 47 after them. Saria Fairmoon's chain runs through Lady Sesspira's key (one named mob). Reclaiming Ravencrest and The Head of the Serpent are conditional; Warlord Krellian is level 55. The two furbolg chains at Ursolan (15 quests) are not in QuestieDB and their Wowhead pages state no side: conditional. Dragonscale Leatherworking at Peter Galen (37.6,65.4) is a gate at Leatherworking 225. Beneath Nordrassil goes back to Darnassus and is left for round 3.

chapters.title: Un'Goro Crater
chapters.note: Talrendis Point - Gadgetzan by flight (The Borrower to Curgle Cranklehop), then Marshal's Refuge on foot (flight point taken there). The stretch chapter: its quests need level 47 to 50 and run to level 54-55 mobs. He does what his level opens, in order of required level; on required quests alone that is about half of the list, and the rest is where round 3 starts. It's a Secret to Everybody is done to Linken; its last part goes to Winterspring and is carried.

chapters.title: Ironforge: the round's hand-ins
chapters.note: Closing stop of the round: Marshal's Refuge - Gadgetzan - Theramore, the Menethil boat, Ironforge. The Explorers' League hand-ins for the Uldum chain (Return to Ironforge, A Future Task) and Tymor's (Return to Tymor), the training rows not yet bought (46, 48, and 50 if reached), the profession ranks still open, and a check with Eldrun for a level-50 class quest (the Classic ones are Horde-side on Wowhead).
